brief:
The United States has designated a Palestinian refugee residing in Germany as a terrorist, according to Drop Site News. The man said he learned of the designation after authorities placed him on the list without any advance notification or contact. "I was frightened," he told the outlet. "The authorities did not contact me beforehand; they just put me on the list."

The terrorist designation carries significant legal and practical implications for the refugee's status in Germany and his access to financial services, employment, and other aspects of daily life. The U.S. has not publicly disclosed the specific allegations, evidence, or reasoning behind the decision to add him to its terrorist watch list.

title: U.S. designates Palestinian refugee in Germany as terrorist
